description: tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py currently skips all root-level src/holon_coherence/*.py modules, letting bidirectional and 3-node cycles involving payload_cleaner, reduction_passes, hybrid_cache, providers, and proxy go unguarded.
goal: Extend apps/holon-coherence/main/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py -> tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py to treat root-level src/holon_coherence/*.py modules (excluding __init__.py) as top-level graph nodes alongside subpackages (updating relative/absolute import resolution cleanly so imports targeting root modules or submodules inside subpackages resolve to their top-level node), lock all currently observed live cyclic edges in BASELINE_CYCLE_EDGES at their bcad21c86e baseline counts (so shrinking passes while any new or expanded root<->subpackage or root<->root cycle fails), and add synthetic AST unit tests in tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py verifying that a newly introduced root<->subpackage or root<->root cycle fails the ratchet while shrinking a recorded cycle edge passes. Keep tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py cleanly under the 1,000-line test file cap, keep holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched, preserve all existing tests, and verify uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Covering root-level modules in test_import_cycle_ratchet.py closes the blind spot around payload_cleaner, hybrid_cache, reduction_passes, and settings before further Coherence refactors.
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py includes root-level src/holon_coherence/*.py modules alongside subpackages and locks all existing cyclic pairs at or below their baseline edge counts.
Synthetic AST unit tests verify a newly introduced root<->subpackage or root<->root cycle fails while shrinking a recorded cycle edge count passes.
uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass with zero docstrings or comments.
